# HTTP API reference

<!-- Generated by `go run ./tools/docgen`. Do not edit by hand: change the code and regenerate. -->

Every route the server exposes. Routes marked **public** need no sign-in; all others need a session cookie or an `X-API-Key` header (see the Profile page). Responses are JSON; errors are `{"error": "..."}`.

| Method | Path | Access | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/activity` | signed in |  |
